data.title: 伽玛 · 训练场上的平地摔
data.description: 庭园训练场上，伽玛难得亲自下场练习剑术。理论她倒背如流，身体却完全不听话——这一跤摔得结结实实，她坐在地上，眼眶发红，却还是攥紧了剑。
data.location: shadow garden training ground with wooden dummies and weapon racks
data.action: sitting on the ground after a clumsy fall, holding a practice sword, teary frustrated expression, refusing to give up
data.lighting: 训练场正午的明亮日光
data.promptProse: Gamma understands every sword form perfectly — her feet simply refuse. Fallen but unbowed, she grips her sword again.
data.animaCaption: The weakest of the Seven Shadows falls again, and stands up again. That, too, is Gamma.
